title: 65-KM Road Project Worth KSh 2.1 Billion Underway in Bomet

verified_facts.label: EXPECTED_IMPACT
verified_facts.value: The project is expected to unlock the economic potential of the area and wider Bomet County

official_statement.speaker: Deputy President Kithure Kindiki
official_statement.quote: The Roads and Transport Ministry has been instructed to closely monitor the performance of road construction to ensure speedy completion and quality works now that the sustainable funding for road construction has been unlocked by the president.

summary: Construction is ongoing on a 65-kilometre road project linking Kyogong, Kapkesosio, Sigor and Chebunyo, with another section running through Sigor, Lelaitich, Kipreres and Longisa in Bomet County. The Bomet County Government says the project is being constructed at a cost of KSh 2.1 billion in Chepalungu Constituency and is expected to unlock the economic potential of the area and the wider county.

confirmed: Construction works on the road project are ongoing.
The reported project cost is KSh 2.1 billion.
The project is located in Chepalungu Constituency, Bomet County.
The Bomet County Government says the project is expected to unlock economic potential in the area and wider county.
Deputy President Kithure Kindiki called for close monitoring of road construction to ensure speedy completion and quality works.
unconfirmed: Exact number of residents or businesses expected to benefit.
